locations.note: On a tip from Anaya Lara finds a stone dais in the ruined city of Tiwanaku, tied to her mother's disappearance; the game ends here too.
Peruvian tombs reveal that Lara's presumed-dead friend Amanda Evert survived.
Lara confronts yakuza boss Shogo Takamoto in Tokyo over a stolen sword fragment.
A Soviet-era research base in Kazakhstan once tried to weaponise a fragment of the sword.
The decoded shield map leads to an Arthurian tourist attraction in Cornwall, built over the tombs of Arthur and his knights.
Lara explores a hidden temple in Ghana that her father Richard once investigated.
Lara returns to the Nepalese monastery where her mother vanished years earlier.
Lara's manor, with Zip and Alister supporting her missions; a full level to explore.

routes.name: The sword and Lara's mother
routes.note: Lara chases the pieces of Excalibur from Tiwanaku through Peru, Tokyo, Ghana, Kazakhstan, Cornwall and Nepal, and ends at the dais in Tiwanaku where it began.
